shapes.label: Bounty
shapes.premise: Something has been killing, and somebody is paying to have it stopped.

shapes.label: Fetch
shapes.premise: Somebody needs a quantity of something and will not go and get it themselves.

shapes.label: Delivery
shapes.premise: Something has to be somewhere else, and the road between is the problem.

shapes.label: Clear-out
shapes.premise: Something has moved into a place that people need back.

shapes.label: Escort
shapes.premise: Somebody has to get somewhere alive, and there are reasons they might not.

shapes.label: Recovery
shapes.premise: Something was lost or taken, and its absence is costing somebody dearly.

shapes.label: Investigation
shapes.premise: Something happened, the account of it does not hold together, and somebody wants the truth.

shapes.label: Heist
shapes.premise: Something is held somewhere it should not be, behind people who will not hand it over.

shapes.label: Defence
shapes.premise: Something is coming, the date is known, and the place cannot hold as it stands.

shapes.label: Diplomacy
shapes.premise: Two parties are one insult from open trouble, and somebody would rather they were not.

pitches: It should take a day. It will not take a day.

outcomes.text: Done clean: the thing is where it should be and nobody the party liked is dead.
Most of it done, and the part left undone comes back later.
Done, but loudly, and the wrong people now know the party's faces.
Not done, but the party knows why now, and that is worth something to somebody.
Not done, and the party is the reason: what they broke cannot be put back.
